exposure: neonatal jaundice with intensive phototherapy or blood exchange transfusion
cohort: 118,222 neonates born in Taiwan between 2004 and 2010, categorized by their neonatal jaundice status and treatment received.
finding: Neonatal jaundice, regardless of treatment intensity, was significantly associated with an increased risk of autism spectrum disorder and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
birth_weight: >2500 grams (for subgroup analysis where association was significant)
